footnote: A zero-shot NLI classifier behind a TypeSafe-compatible server, not a trained decision model: it scores each option as an entailment hypothesis with ModernBERT-large-zeroshot-v2.0. Its choice path runs several NLI passes over the same state, which the reported token count does not include, so a per-token hosted price would be higher than the estimate here. Pre-registered for our CPU in v1.2.7, run on our GPU because the CPU was far too slow.
